title: How I use HTMX with Go
summary: Alex Edwards explains his approach to combining HTMX with Go for building modern, interactive web applications with minimal JavaScript. The article demonstrates practical patterns for integrating server-side rendered HTML with HTMX's progressive enhancement capabilities, leveraging Go's simplicity for backend logic.
problem_solved: Enables developers to build dynamic, reactive web applications without writing complex client-side JavaScript code.
why_valuable: Provides a practical, battle-tested approach to modern web development that combines the best of server-side rendering with lightweight client-side interactivity.
